new_claims.statement: For independent cap-one Y, nonzero M, stable rank r=floor(||M||HS^2/||M||op^2), beta=3r/4, and 0<alpha<beta, sup_z E||MY-z||^{-alpha} <= C_*^alpha beta/(beta-alpha)||M||HS^{-alpha}, where C_*=C_{1/4} is the universal constant from Rudelson--Vershynin Theorem 1.5/Remark 1.7.
For a zero-self original-coordinate block X in R(Y,W)+2 X^T M Y+b(W)^T X+c(W)^T Y, stable rank(M)>=2 implies ||p||infinity <=(3 C_*/sqrt(2))||M||HS^{-1}.
If a genuine physical scalar square a(X0+L)^2 precedes the same zero-self block, every nonzero M suffices and ||p_Q||infinity <=3*2^(5/4)*sqrt(C_*)|a|^{-1/2}||M||HS^{-1/2}.
In that Schur scope, det A[{0,i,j}]=-a M_ij^2; account02/B01 r25 gives 216|a|^{-1/3}|M_ij|^{-2/3} for concentrated entries, while the new HS theorem pays diffuse aggregate cross energy.

partner_result_applied.application: Exact Schur identity det A[{0,i,j}]=-a M_ij^2 converts the partner principal-triple theorem into ||p_Q||infinity<=216|a|^{-1/3}|M_ij|^{-2/3}.

partner_correction_consumed.application: The target-valid Hadamard construction makes worst scalar conditional-fiber suprema infinite; the new mechanism averages a translation-uniform linear-image fractional trace instead.
